caseNameFull: Friend v. Reno, Attorney General Stevens v. Michigan

opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir.; and

Sup. Ct. Mich. Motions of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. *1073Petitioners are allowed until January 31, 2000, within which to pay the docketing fees required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
